    • ArmSim

      public ArmSim(MechanismSimParams params, double massKg, double cgRadiusMeters, double gravityAccel, double gravityOffsetRad)
      Creates an arm simulation.
      Parameters:
      params - mechanism parameters
      massKg - arm mass in kilograms
      cgRadiusMeters - center of gravity distance in meters
      gravityAccel - gravity acceleration in meters per second squared
      gravityOffsetRad - offset added to the arm angle for gravity torque
